Position gene labels within the panel at draw time

Source: R/geom-gene-track.R
place_gene_labels.Rd

Places each label at its requested gene end if it fits in the panel, otherwise at the opposite gene end, otherwise centered above the visible part of the gene. Called by the label grob once the panel size is known. For internal use only.

Usage

place_gene_labels(label_grob)

Arguments

label_grob

gTree of class gene_label_grob built by GeomGeneLabel
